accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1–3
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The full efficiency and attainment claims are pointwise, fixed-T results under retained-cell overlap and fixed separated conditional contrast rank.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Canonicality and attainment are claimed only on the fixed-rank, separated-spectrum staggered-DDD observed-law model; uniform rank-changing inference is not claimed.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 4 (efficiency-gap inference)
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Gap inference assumes local comparator-KKT rank stability, sieve-Riesz approximation, and separation away from the equality boundary.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The Wald result is pointwise for Delta_cmp(P)>=delta_0>0 and does not assert valid inference on the equality boundary.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper identifies staggered-DDD ATT(g,t) using alternative clean cohorts, permits within-target weighted combinations, interprets its DR-GMM estimator through recentered influence functions, and establishes its optimality within weighted averages for each target.

source_verification_receipts.locator: PDF p. 8, Theorem 5 and equation (6); pp. 11–13, Theorem 7 and repeated-cross-section discussion.
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 5 gives the nonparametric panel-DDD efficient influence function for the paper's basic panel target, while Theorem 7 treats its repeated-cross-section target; neither theorem states an all-clean-cohort staggered-DDD conditional projection result.

The article derives an efficient DiD ATT procedure under compositional changes and proposes a Hausman-type comparison with the stationarity-based estimator; it does not study a DDD conditional-versus-constant optimized variance functional.

The paper develops stacked DDD with transparent pairwise stacks and fixed-weight inference, explicitly presenting the approach as trading efficiency for transparency rather than deriving a conditional efficiency bound.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the field-level novelty sentence explicit in the headline: the first semiparametric efficiency bound with an attaining estimator for an overidentified all-clean-cohort staggered-DDD aggregate, rather than a generic conditional-GLS improvement.
Add a compact worked observed-law tangent matrix for the binary witness, showing the conditional normal directions and the projection that produces b-star in each X stratum.
Develop the rank-adaptive handle into a concrete uniform-inference theorem over a named local spectral-gap class, with an explicit rank-selection rule and critical-value construction.

recommended_next_step: Advance to Stage 0 with tangent-exhaustion for the binary witness as the first proof checkpoint and the fixed-rank/separated-spectrum scope treated as settled conditional scope.
